translations.legal.imprint.title: Imprint
translations.legal.imprint.disclosure: Disclosure under § 25 of the Austrian Media Act (MedienG)
translations.legal.imprint.contentText: A private, non-commercial web app that scores and analyses darts games with a smartphone camera. It grew out of a bachelor's thesis.
translations.legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
translations.legal.privacy.controllerText: The app is run privately and not for profit. There is no advertising, no tracking and no analytics service.
translations.legal.privacy.accountText: For an account we store your email address, username, display name, your password only as a hash, your role and when you registered and confirmed your email. With these you sign in, your games are assigned to you and you receive emails for confirmation and password resets.
translations.legal.privacy.accountBasis: The legal basis is providing the app you use (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
translations.legal.privacy.gamesText: For every game we store the mode, the players, every dart with its field, position on the board and time, and the course of play including corrections. In addition there is your player list, your settings and which games you have hidden. From this come the score, history, replays and statistics.
translations.legal.privacy.gamesShared: Whoever plays a game with you sees your name and your throws in it. Games without an account are stored without reference to a person, only with the names entered for the players.
translations.legal.privacy.gamesBasis: The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
translations.legal.privacy.cameraText: The camera picture is analysed in your browser. Only when a throw is detected does a still image go to the server, which determines the score from it. The images stay there in memory only for the duration of the game and are not stored permanently.
translations.legal.privacy.cameraTests: The exception are test runs the operator starts to measure the accuracy of the detection. Their images are stored for this evaluation.
translations.legal.privacy.accessText: On every request the server logs the IP address, time, the address requested and your browser's identifier. This serves operation, troubleshooting and protection against abuse, for example by limiting sign-in attempts. The logs have a fixed size and are continuously overwritten.
translations.legal.privacy.accessBasis: The legal basis is our legitimate interest in secure operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
translations.legal.privacy.cookiesText: One cookie keeps you signed in. It cannot be read by scripts and lasts at most 30 days. A second one remembers the chosen language for a year. In addition your browser keeps in local storage which game is running, an identifier for the connection and views such as the muted caller. This data stays on your device.
translations.legal.privacy.cookiesBasis: Both are technically necessary for the app and therefore need no consent (§ 165(3) TKG 2021).
translations.legal.privacy.hosting: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Hosting:{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} The app runs on the operator's own server in Austria.
translations.legal.privacy.cloudflare: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Cloudflare, Inc. (USA):{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} All requests pass through Cloudflare, which encrypts the connection and protects against attacks. Cloudflare sees the IP address and request data in doing so. The transfer to the USA is based on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
translations.legal.privacy.brevo: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France):{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} sends the emails for confirmation, password resets and changes of email address, and receives your email address and the content of the email for this.
translations.legal.privacy.noOthers: Beyond that, no data is passed on.
translations.legal.privacy.retentionText: Your account and games stay stored until you delete your account. Then the account, settings and the games no other account played in are deleted. Shared games remain for the others; in them you only appear as “Deleted player”.
translations.legal.privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection (Art. 15 to 21 GDPR). To exercise them, write to {$START_LINK}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_LINK}. You can also delete your account yourself in your profile.
translations.legal.privacy.complaint: You can lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority, Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna, {$START_LINK}dsb.gv.at{$CLOSE_LINK}.
